result.title: DriveDreamer-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Driving Perception and Agentic Data Generation
result.summary: Controllable generation can expand training data for driving perception, but visual realism alone does not ensure learning gains. Effective generation must adapt both what data to generate and how to construct them as the perception model evolves. In this paper, we present DriveDreamer-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement of driving perception and agentic data generation through feedback between perception learning and data construction. Its outer loop implements Gap-Guided Target Adaptation, generating labeled videos from current perception gaps and updating targets after training. Its inner loop uses a vision-language agent to iteratively edit scenes through observation and execution feedback. Across rounds, Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement derives reusable construction advice from execution experience and downstream learning outcomes. On the nuScenes validation set, DriveDreamer-RSI surpasses the dataset-replay baseline by 4.09 mAP and 4.13 NDS points using approximately half the synthetic frames.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DriveDreamer-RSI，在感知学习与数据构造间建立反馈以实现递归自提升：外循环依当前感知缺口生成带标签视频并更新目标，内循环用 VLM 智能体依观察与执行反馈迭代编辑场景，并从执行经验和下游学习结果提炼可复用的构造策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但「依下游学习缺口重设目标、依执行反馈迭代、由学习结果反推策略」的闭环，可能为 latent 轨迹训练的监督分配及证据获取、何时停止等决策提供类比线索，可供核查。
